author: Xuph
body:
Farmyard TE CTW Made by Xuph & imryaan.

Album (PLEASE READ THE SUBTITLES UNDER EVERY IMAGE) : http://imgur.com/a/2gJ48

XML (soon)

DL (not provided for TE maps)

Map features:

- Red vs Yellow.
- 1 Wool per team.
- Spawners in middle (Haste 1 eight seconds, Regeneration 2 four seconds) (UNBREAKABLE).
- Y 24 Height limit (Map is on Y 0). 
- Loadout does not include a lot of wood, makes the gameplay not too much skybridge based. Middle is controlable and has spawners, encouraging a game that is about control.
- 6v6 TE
- Gold mines (no iron/diamond)
- Unique design for woolroom.
- Safeties are enabled

Credits to Legoche for the screenshot and Xuph for the editing

Check out our other map, Outbreak DTM TE!: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/c316d1c4b

replies.author: Xuph
replies.body: this can be played 7v7 as well. by TE we didnt directly mean for tourneys, we meant more for scrims. we made this map simply because we constantly see situations where smaller teams want to scrim and either dont have enough players in general or they just want a smaller scrim. if you want to use this for tourneys go ahead. we just planned this will be used more in scrims.

replies.author: Legoche
replies.body:
I helped testing this map, especially the defence area. The idea behind the map was not to have a large wall but to rather dig a big pit (since there is a low height limit this is good), this is why you have low supply amounts.

If this plays well it will probably be the hardest map to defend on since there is a lack of supplies and takes a lot of skill to defend.

replies.author: Xuph
replies.body:
tbh i feel youre saying that as youre a defender... but its ok, so let me explain

the wool is far away from spawn and theres only one wool. we were afraid this will be really stale. therefore we did everything to make defending harder and rushing easier. however we still made low height limit so you dont really deal with sky as a defender on this map. theres luck of supplies, one lane, tunnelable bedrock wall, and a wall on the front thats blocking your eyesight (as a defender). so defending takes a lot of skill and practice.

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The map looks really good. I love the different colored blocks you used for the sides (one green one brown). The detail with fences tooks really good and the hay adds an interesting look to the map.

If this would be a map for public play, I'd recommend adding something for defenders because with the layout right now, I don't think people would defend but since this is a tournament map, I think the longer paths to the wool will be a great addition and might open room for good teamwork plays to get players back to their side from the wool room.

I really hope this plays well because it looks like it has a lot of potential.
